# API Requirements Quality Checklist: US-05 — Backend Read API for Live Corridor State

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review ("unit tests for English") for the two read-only corridor endpoints, focused on contract conformance, no-data/error behaviour, and freshness/trust semantics.
**Created**: 2026-11-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for both endpoints (corridor-state and source-status) with their exact request shape documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec state what identifies the "latest" snapshot, so a reader knows which record is returned when several exist? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements present for the error-response contents (what the generic error body must and must not contain)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the no-data condition specified for both endpoints, including the shape of the response for each? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008 / Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the fields that distinguish a `live` from an `estimated` source-status response enumerated in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the expected behaviour specified when gold cannot populate a contract-required field (escalate vs. default)? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases / Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "read-only" defined precisely enough to be checkable (which layers may be read, which must never be written)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the "more than 2 minutes" staleness threshold stated unambiguously (inclusive/exclusive boundary, measured from which timestamp)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "implies no alert" defined in observable terms, so a reviewer can tell whether a response satisfies it? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006 / US-05.2]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "well-formed, clearly distinguishable" no-data response quantified with the exact distinguishing field/value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the branch name for this feature stated consistently across artifacts (`feature/US-05-backend-read-api` vs `004-backend-read-api`)? [Ambiguity, Spec header vs plan header]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the two endpoints' responses reference the same contract versions (v1.0.0) consistently across spec, plan, and the OpenAPI contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003/FR-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the no-data `status` convention consistent between the two endpoints (source-status first-class `no_data` vs corridor-now sibling envelope), and is that difference deliberately documented? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the corridor scope statements consistent (C6-008, direction 1 only) across spec, plan, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK015 Do the "out of scope" lists (auth/RBAC, push, history/pagination) agree between spec Assumptions and plan Evolution? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-002 (100% of responses validate against the contracts with no extra/missing fields) be objectively verified from the requirement as written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Can SC-003 (stale bus correctly reflected in 100% of cases) be measured against a defined stale-bus condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-004 (no error exposes internals; every error carries a matchable correlation id) stated so that both halves are independently checkable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Is SC-005 (a client can generate a typed client from published docs) expressed with an objective success condition rather than a subjective judgement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for the healthy/all-reporting path (source status `live`, empty down-sources set)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the single-stale-bus path (status `estimated`, bus listed as down)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the empty-gold path on BOTH endpoints, not just one? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for the unexpected-internal-failure path (generic body + correlation id, no leakage)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the contract-field-unavailable path (escalation rather than a silent default)? [Coverage, Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the response for a corridor other than C6-008 specified (unknown/unsupported corridor returns the same no-data envelope, HTTP 200, echoing the requested id)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011 / Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Is it explicitly stated that no latency/throughput SLO applies to this read API in the active turn, so its absence is intentional rather than an omission? [Completeness, Plan Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the security requirements that DO apply this turn (parameterized SQL, no secrets, no stack-trace leakage) stated as requirements rather than only as plan notes? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-005/FR-007]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the deferral of freshness-SLO / `age_s` staleness gating recorded as evolution so it is not read as a missing requirement? [Non-Functional, Plan Evolution]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Is the assumption that the `corridor_now`/`source_status` v1.0.0 contracts already exist and are approved stated and validated? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the assumption that the gold layer already produces the consumed snapshots documented, with producing/transforming that data marked out of scope? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the dependency on the existing global exception handler (for FR-007) captured as a requirement-level assumption rather than only an implementation detail? [Dependency, Plan Constraints]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the claim of "no dependencies on other unstarted stories" stated and checkable? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK033 Does the spec resolve where the no-data `status` value lives for corridor-now (sibling envelope) so it cannot be mistaken for a `corridor_now` contract field? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 Does the spec reconcile the no-data `status` envelope with the "contract-fields-only" rule by stating the envelope is an API-level sibling, not a mutation of the `corridor_now` contract document? [Conflict resolved, Spec §FR-003/FR-004/FR-008]
- [ ] CHK035 Is a requirement & acceptance-criteria ID scheme (FR-/SC-/US-) applied consistently so every behaviour traces to an identifier? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
